translations.web: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.
translations.bsb: Like a broken tooth or a foot out of joint is confidence in a faithless man in time of trouble.
translations.kjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
